events.text: The museum was located in Munich in the arsenal of the Bavarian army until 1905.

events.text: The museum moved into a new monumental building at the Hofgarten in Munich.

events.text: The Armeemuseum has been housed in the Bavarian National Museum in Munich since 1946.
